proofs.segment_equivalence:
by
  intro input outside
  refine ⟨⟨fun t => if t = 0 then 8 else if t = 1 then 8 else 0,
    fun t => match t with
      | 0 => fun r => if r = 0 then some 0 else if r = 1 then some 2 else none
      | 1 => fun r => if r = 0 then some 1 else if r = 1 then some 2 else none
      | _ => fun _ => none,
    fun t => match t with
      | 0 => fun r => if r = 0 then some (ops.add (ops.add (ops.add (ops.literal 0 1) (ops.mul (ops.fromHalf (input 0 0)) (ops.fromHalf (input 1 0)))) (ops.mul (ops.fromHalf (input 0 1)) (ops.fromHalf (input 1 1)))) (ops.mul (ops.fromHalf (input 0 2)) (ops.fromHalf (input 1 2)))) else none
      | 1 => fun r => if r = 0 then some (ops.add (ops.add (ops.add (ops.literal 0 1) (ops.mul (ops.fromHalf (input 0 3)) (ops.fromHalf (input 1 0)))) (ops.mul (ops.fromHalf (input 0 4)) (ops.fromHalf (input 1 1)))) (ops.mul (ops.fromHalf (input 0 5)) (ops.fromHalf (input 1 2)))) else none
      | _ => fun _ => none,
    fun l =>
      if l = ⟨.global, 0, 2, 0⟩ then
        some (ops.toHalf (ops.add (ops.add (ops.add (ops.literal 0 1) (ops.mul (ops.fromHalf (input 0 0)) (ops.fromHalf (input 1 0)))) (ops.mul (ops.fromHalf (input 0 1)) (ops.fromHalf (input 1 1)))) (ops.mul (ops.fromHalf (input 0 2)) (ops.fromHalf (input 1 2)))))
      else if l = ⟨.global, 0, 2, 1⟩ then
        some (ops.toHalf (ops.add (ops.add (ops.add (ops.literal 0 1) (ops.mul (ops.fromHalf (input 0 3)) (ops.fromHalf (input 1 0)))) (ops.mul (ops.fromHalf (input 0 4)) (ops.fromHalf (input 1 1)))) (ops.mul (ops.fromHalf (input 0 5)) (ops.fromHalf (input 1 2)))))
      else (initial layout input outside).memory l,
    fun _ => {}, traceData⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
